history.body: Hi, I came across your property ad. I’m comparing renting and buying at the moment.

That’s a sensible comparison. Pearl’s Phase 1 homes are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony; the extra room could be useful for work or guests, depending on what you need. Would you be considering buying mainly for your own stay, or as an investment?
Probably for myself if I buy, but I’m only comparing for now. I’d need to see whether the monthly cost makes sense.

That makes sense—the monthly outlay is the key comparison. Pearl’s stated maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of sinking fund; the mortgage would be separate and depends on your financing terms, so I wouldn’t want to guess the full monthly cost. What monthly housing spend would feel comfortable for you?
